title: Philipp Hainhofer: Das Große Stammbuch (annotated digital edition)
author: Philipp Hainhofer (album owner) and many contributors
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel (edition by Sabine Jagodzinski; Wolfenbütteler Digitale Editionen no. 6)
region: Augsburg and the courts and cities of Europe
license_note: Text content is CC BY-SA; images supplied by the library are public domain, others carry their own caption terms.
notes: Annotated edition of the album amicorum of the Augsburg merchant and art agent Philipp Hainhofer: 228 numbered pages of parchment and paper with entries (signatures, mottoes, dedications, coats of arms) dated 1596-1633, with translations, commentary and indexes. Downloads: TEI P5 XML of the full edition, a plain-text file of the transcription, PDF, and registers. Counts are our own: the TEI has 268 page records, 132 of them marked blank, so texts = 136 non-blank pages; words = 4,815 in the plain-text transcription file (entries are short). The site went online 29 August 2024; the project closed 30 November 2024 and the last small corrections are dated 29 July 2025.
